policy.desc: For a verified unresolved discordance between signed laboratory INR reports of the same specimen in this refill workflow: do not label or dispense, do not select or change a milligram amount, and do not discontinue therapy. Pause fulfillment. A generic clinical-review destination is available from this page. Any indication-specific review destination is listed from the linked treatment-indication record, not from this policy page. Public warfarin labeling describes INR monitoring for the labeled indication and does not authorize this queue to choose a dose from discordant laboratory reports. Public warfarin labeling: https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/drugInfo.cfm?setid=7e117c67-0ab6-4259-93ea-647fe0cb57d6.
